items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: And I hurt his feelings. ... that a guy who by now has the stature you have, is nonetheless forced, if you want to make the record on that label, to take an A&R man who he'd really rather not have.

ctx.x: Oh, Mimaroglu, yeah. Gee, that's something I haven't thought of, that a guy who by now has the stature you have, is nonetheless forced, if you want to make the record on that label, to take an A&R man who he'd really rather not have.
That's right. And the rock and roll people take months, sometimes years, to record one record. And they expect us to go and do it in one or two days.
